facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, under Common Monetary Area exchange control, through commercial banks.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks offer foreign-currency accounts; individual eligibility not separately confirmed.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with BIPA; steps not confirmed yet.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from NamRA, issued on registration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Namibian-source income taxed: 0% to NAD 100,000, rising to 37%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT above N$1 million in any 12 months.
facts.L5_data_protection: No data protection law yet; a bill was tabled in 2025.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: E-commerce consumer rights exist on paper but aren't in force yet.

watch_out.text: The 7-day cooling-off right some guides cite isn't in force yet.
Older pages say N$500,000; the VAT threshold is now N$1 million.
